name: career-changer-teacher-to-analyst
description: Math teacher pivoting to junior data analyst. Genuine transferable evidence (Excel, basic dashboards, statistics) but core tooling gaps (SQL, Power BI). Should land mid-low with the right gaps flagged.
resumeText:
NOURA AL-MUTAIRI
Mathematics Teacher | Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
noura.mutairi@email.com

SUMMARY
Mathematics teacher with 5 years of experience, now transitioning into data analysis. Comfortable with Excel and basic statistics; completed a part-time data analytics bootcamp in 2025.

EXPERIENCE

Mathematics Teacher — Al-Rowad International School, Riyadh | Sep 2020 – Present
- Teach algebra and statistics to 150 students per year across grades 10-12.
- Built Excel gradebooks with pivot tables and conditional formatting used by the whole math department (8 teachers).
- Created a Google Sheets dashboard tracking student performance trends per unit, used in parent-teacher meetings.
- Analyzed exam results per topic to redesign the term plan; pass rates improved from 78% to 91% over two years.

EDUCATION
B.Sc. Mathematics — Princess Nourah University, 2020
Data Analytics Bootcamp (part-time, 12 weeks) — Tuwaiq Academy, 2025: Excel, intro statistics, data visualization fundamentals

SKILLS
Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, charts), Google Sheets, descriptive statistics, data visualization basics, curriculum planning, Arabic (native), English (professional)
jobDescription:
Junior Data Analyst

We are looking for a junior analyst to support the operations team.

Requirements:
- Strong Excel (pivot tables, lookups) — daily use
- Working SQL: joins and aggregations against our PostgreSQL reporting database
- Build and maintain Power BI dashboards for operations KPIs
- Solid grasp of descriptive statistics
- Communicate findings clearly to non-technical staff
- Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field

Entry level: 0-2 years of analyst experience accepted; demonstrated analytical work required.
